title: Android Developer

nodes.title: Kotlin Language Fundamentals & Idioms
nodes.subtitle: Variables, null safety, data classes, extension functions, lambdas, smart casts
learning_objectives: Leverage Kotlin null safety (?., ?:, !!) to eliminate NullPointerExceptions
Write expressive code using extension functions, lambdas, and data classes
feynman_prompts: How does Kotlin's compile-time null safety guarantee zero NullPointerExceptions at runtime?
key_misconceptions: Overusing the !! force-unwrap operator, reintroducing crash risks

nodes.title: Kotlin Coroutines & Reactive Flows
nodes.subtitle: Coroutines, dispatchers (Main, IO, Default), viewModelScope, StateFlow vs SharedFlow
learning_objectives: Execute background asynchronous operations without blocking the main UI thread
Stream reactive state updates using StateFlow and SharedFlow
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between Dispatchers.Main and Dispatchers.IO in Android.
key_misconceptions: Launching long-running network or database calls on Dispatchers.Main, freezing the UI

nodes.title: Android Architecture & Lifecycle Mechanics
nodes.subtitle: Activity & Fragment lifecycle, ViewModel, SavedStateHandle, process death
learning_objectives: Manage screen rotation and configuration changes safely using ViewModel
Restore UI state across system process death with SavedStateHandle
feynman_prompts: Why does ViewModel survive device configuration changes (rotations) while Activities are destroyed?
key_misconceptions: Storing Activity Context references inside ViewModels, causing permanent memory leaks

nodes.title: Jetpack Compose: Declarative UI Foundations
nodes.subtitle: Composables, modifier system, Row, Column, Box, LazyColumn for dynamic lists
learning_objectives: Build modern declarative Android user interfaces with Jetpack Compose
Implement performant scrollable lists with LazyColumn and itemsIndexed
feynman_prompts: How does declarative UI in Compose differ from the legacy imperative XML View system?
key_misconceptions: Creating un-memoized heavy objects inside composable functions that re-execute on every recomposition

nodes.title: Compose State & Recomposition Optimization
nodes.subtitle: remember, mutableStateOf, derivedStateOf, recomposition scopes, state hoisting
learning_objectives: Manage unidirectional data flow with state hoisting in composables
Optimize performance by minimizing unnecessary recompositions using derivedStateOf
feynman_prompts: Explain why state hoisting makes composables reusable, testable, and previewable.
key_misconceptions: Mutating standard Kotlin variables directly, expecting Compose to detect changes without mutableStateOf

nodes.title: Jetpack Navigation & Deep Linking
nodes.subtitle: Navigation Compose, NavHost, type-safe route arguments, deep link handling
learning_objectives: Configure type-safe navigation graphs and handle screen back stacks cleanly
Handle incoming deep links and route directly into nested application screens
feynman_prompts: How does Navigation Compose maintain separate ViewModel instances per destination back stack entry?
key_misconceptions: Passing complex large objects through navigation arguments instead of passing unique IDs

nodes.title: Dependency Injection with Hilt
nodes.subtitle: @HiltAndroidApp, @AndroidEntryPoint, @Inject, @Module, scopes (@Singleton, @ViewModelScoped)
learning_objectives: Decouple application components using compile-time dependency injection with Hilt
Scope dependencies accurately to ViewModels and application lifecycles
feynman_prompts: Why is dependency injection essential for writing unit tests in Android applications?
key_misconceptions: Injecting Activity-scoped dependencies into Singleton services, causing memory leaks

nodes.title: Offline Persistence with Room Database
nodes.subtitle: Entities, DAOs, RoomDatabase, type converters, migrations, reactive Flow queries
learning_objectives: Persist structured application data offline using Room SQLite abstractions
Observe real-time database changes reactively using Kotlin Flows
feynman_prompts: Why should Room database queries always be executed off the main thread?
key_misconceptions: Accessing Room database instances synchronously on the main thread, causing ANR crashes

nodes.title: Networking: Retrofit, OkHttp & Serialization
nodes.subtitle: Retrofit interfaces, OkHttp interceptors, Kotlinx.serialization, error handling
learning_objectives: Define clean REST API interfaces and deserialize JSON payloads
Implement OkHttp interceptors for auth token injection and retry policies
feynman_prompts: How do OkHttp interceptors enable centralized authentication header management?
key_misconceptions: Parsing JSON payloads manually inside UI composables

nodes.title: Background Work with WorkManager
nodes.subtitle: PeriodicWorkRequest, OneTimeWorkRequest, constraints (network, battery), chaining tasks
learning_objectives: Schedule guaranteed background synchronization tasks that survive device reboots
Enforce battery and network constraints on background workers
feynman_prompts: Why is WorkManager preferred for deferrable guaranteed work over Foreground Services?
key_misconceptions: Using raw background threads for tasks that must complete even if the app process is terminated

nodes.title: Material Design 3 & Dynamic Theming
nodes.subtitle: Material 3 design tokens, dynamic color, typography, shape schemes, dark mode
learning_objectives: Implement Material Design 3 dynamic theming adapting to Android 12+ wallpaper colors
Support seamless light and dark mode switching with high accessibility contrast
feynman_prompts: How does Material Design 3 dynamic color generation work on modern Android devices?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding static hex color codes directly into composable UI widgets

nodes.title: Clean Architecture & MVVM Repository Pattern
nodes.subtitle: Presentation, Domain (Use Cases), Data layers, repository pattern, boundary separation
learning_objectives: Structure enterprise Android codebases into Clean Architecture layers
Encapsulate complex multi-source business logic inside reusable Use Cases / Interactors
feynman_prompts: Why should the Domain layer have zero dependencies on Android framework classes (android.*)?
key_misconceptions: Calling repository database methods directly from UI composable functions

nodes.title: Android Unit Testing: ViewModels & Use Cases
nodes.subtitle: JUnit5, Mockk, kotlinx-coroutines-test, TestDispatcher, Turbine for Flows
learning_objectives: Write fast deterministic unit tests for ViewModels using TestDispatcher
Test reactive StateFlow emissions deterministically with Turbine
feynman_prompts: Why is StandardTestDispatcher necessary to control virtual time in coroutine unit tests?
key_misconceptions: Running unit tests against real live network endpoints

nodes.title: Compose UI & End-to-End Testing
nodes.subtitle: createComposeRule, onNodeWithText, performClick, SemanticsNode assertions
learning_objectives: Write automated UI tests that verify composable hierarchy behavior
Assert semantics node states and simulate user tap and text input flows
feynman_prompts: How do Compose semantic properties allow testing UI without relying on fragile view IDs?
key_misconceptions: Testing internal implementation state instead of visible user UI elements

nodes.title: Performance Profiling & Memory Leak Detection
nodes.subtitle: Android Profiler, LeakCanary, baseline profiles, frame drops (jank), memory allocations
learning_objectives: Detect and eliminate memory leaks using LeakCanary
Analyze jank and slow frames using Android Studio CPU & Memory Profilers
feynman_prompts: How do static Activity context references cause out-of-memory (OOM) crashes in Android?
key_misconceptions: Ignoring memory allocation churn inside LazyColumn item composables

nodes.title: Android Security & Keystore Encryption
nodes.subtitle: Android Keystore, EncryptedSharedPreferences, biometric prompt, certificate pinning
learning_objectives: Store sensitive API tokens securely using hardware-backed Android Keystore
Implement biometric authentication prompts for sensitive user actions
feynman_prompts: Why is hardware-backed Keystore storage immune to extraction even on rooted devices?
key_misconceptions: Storing unencrypted API keys or auth tokens in standard SharedPreferences

nodes.title: Multi-Module Android Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Feature modules, core modules, api/impl separation, build time optimization
learning_objectives: Decompose monolithic Android apps into decoupled Gradle feature modules
Improve incremental build times and enforce strict architectural boundaries
feynman_prompts: What are the benefits of decoupling feature modules using an api/impl module pattern?
key_misconceptions: Creating circular dependencies between Gradle feature modules

nodes.title: ProGuard, R8 & Google Play Deployment
nodes.subtitle: R8 code shrinking, obfuscation rules, App Bundles (.aab), Google Play Console
learning_objectives: Configure R8 ProGuard rules to shrink and obfuscate production APKs safely
Generate signed Android App Bundles (.aab) and prepare Play Store releases
feynman_prompts: Why is code obfuscation and resource shrinking critical before shipping production Android apps?
key_misconceptions: Disabling R8 minification to avoid fixing keep rules, shipping bloated and reverse-engineerable apps

description: Master Android Developer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
